raw_text: Indian intelligence agencies have flagged a Russian-linked influence operation designed to sway defence procurement towards Moscow's platforms. The campaign used fabricated statistics about Rafale maintenance costs and ITAR vulnerabilities spread through coordinated social media accounts. Defence Ministry sources confirmed the Rafale fleet maintains over 80% serviceability, contradicting claims circulated online.
clean_text: Indian intelligence flags Russian influence operation targeting defence procurement. Defence Ministry confirms Rafale serviceability above 80%, contradicting fabricated statistics in campaign.
